build_argparse_options: build an argparse parser with basic training parameters like name, checkpoint_dir, and batch size
add_optim_options: add optimizer options including learning rate, warmup steps, scheduler, and gradient clipping arguments
add_modeling_options: add modeling options for T5 reader model type, passage retrieval, and generation parameters
add_index_options: add index options for loading saving FAISS or flat index shards and quantization settings
parse_and_get_options: parse command line args and get all options with closed book mode and file passage overrides
